title: Global comparison with affine normalized-map factorizations
statement: For a closed immersion i:Z -> Y of schemes and n a natural number, let B=i_*O_Z and Q=i*H^{-n}(B[0] tensor^L B[0]) in the given derived category on Y. There is a global morphism tau: exteriorSheaf(i*ker(i),n) -> Q. For every open V of Z and affine U of Y, put A=Gamma(Y,U), I=i.ker.ideal U and W=V intersect i^{-1}(U). Let T take an A-module to its associated sheaf on U, push it forward to Y, and tensor-pull it back to Z; let F=T.op followed by duality on Z, restriction to V, and over-site restriction to W. There are coordinate isomorphisms a and b for which the restricted dual of tau is a.hom followed by F.map(selfTorConormalComparison A I n).op followed by b.hom. The algebraic map is the unique Koszul-normalized comparison [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison]. No regularity is assumed in this factorization.

source.place: lemma-divided-powers-on-tor; Tags 062I and 06YH for conormal and derived tensor

proof.text: Sheafify projective quotient resolutions on each affine chart to compute the restriction of the fixed K-flat derived tensor. The quotient scalar action identifies ordinary pullback with the same Tor module on the closed chart.
Identify the tensor-pulled kernel with the conormal module and commute exterior powers with affine sheafification.
Localize the normalized algebraic comparison. Its resolution-independent normalization gives equality on basic open overlaps, so the maps glue to tau.
Dualize its chart coordinate square, then restrict to V and W. These functors preserve the coordinate isomorphisms and yield the displayed equality.

theorem selfTor_conormal_dual_chart_iso
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (n : ℕ) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let Q := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (-(n : ℤ))).obj
          (S.obj B ⊗ S.obj B))
    ∃ τ : Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules) n ⟶ Q,
      ∀ (V : Z.Opens) (U : Y.affineOpens),
        let W := V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
        let F := (selfTorAffineComparisonFunctor i U).op ⋙ Scheme.Modules.dualFunctor Z ⋙
          Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ W
        let c := selfTorConormalComparison (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) (i.ker.ideal U) n
        ∃ (a : (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
              (Scheme.Modules.dual Q)).over W) ≅ F.obj (op _))
          (b : F.obj (op _) ≅ (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
              (Scheme.Modules.dual (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf
                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules) n))).over W)),
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map (Scheme.Modules.dualMap τ)).over W =
            a.hom ≫ F.map c.op ≫ b.hom
